name: Abhishek Saikia
bio_short: I write about technology, system internals and design, and some ideas I stumble upon. I also build tools, prefer containers and infrastructure, and contribute to open source.
bio_long: I'm Abhishek Saikia, a programmer based in India.
I delve in backend and infrastructure engineering - distributed systems, cloud, containers and computer internals. Comfortable in Go, TypeScript, Python, and a bit of Rust and C.
I write here irregularly but with intention.
If something I've written resonated with you, I'd genuinely love to hear about it. Connect with me!.
